lessons: L-M01-1: at 15m cadence with the frozen 5bp taker floor + tick slippage, M01's gross price edge is ~zero; 6916 positions/year turn the strategy into a pure cost-burn. Any future 15m mechanism must show gross edge far above the cost floor or far lower turnover.
L-M01-2: the negative control (C2) matches the mechanism within ~5% of net loss - the preregistered flow signal carried no incremental information over price noise. The control design did its job.

L-CONTRACT-1: the frozen publisher's canonical trial key cannot express arms that differ outside arm_config_id. Preregistered multi-arm families must map every arm to a distinct arm_config_id, or the publisher must be extended BEFORE the freeze. Discovered mid-R3; handled fail-closed (no ledger forgery).

L-DATA-1: data verification must cover the LOADER-SELECTED values (dedupe winners), not just the existence of correct values somewhere in the tree. D2 verified content existence; the dedupe picked non-digit-exact duplicates - caught only by A7's recompute.

L-HOST3-1: the full suite has a side effect on this host: it rewrites research/audits/v7p and v8p golden vector reports; restore both after every suite run. 24 suite tests are platform-idiom failures (POSIX process control, macOS paths, cp1252) - classified, zero in the scored execution path.
